text.en:
AIl other orders, proclamations,
issuances, or portions thereof, which are inconsistent with
this Executive Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive
Order shall take effect
immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of April, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety five.
By the President:
GUINGONA, JR.
Executive Secretary
